t: What Are Riders to Real Estate Purchase and Sale Agreements?
s: September 28, 2023 - If you are purchasing a commercial property you should fully expect to see a rider to the P&S, as it will cover nuances in the transaction that are likely not covered in the standard P&S forms. These might include, for instance: Hazardous waste provisions. These ensure that the property is compliant with hazardous waste concerns, as outlined by state laws. There is language in several standard P&S forms regarding hazardous waste, but it typically doesn't go into enough detail to fully cover the buyer's interests.
